summary: ChowChow Cloud International Holdings Ltd, a Hong Kong-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its September 14, 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting. Shareholders approved all six proposals, including a 10:1 reverse share split (24,547,673 for; 75,550 against; 1,395 abstained), the creation of dual-class Class A (one vote) and Class B (ten votes) ordinary shares (24,496,499 for), and the redesignation of issued and authorized capital, with Rainbow Sun Enterprises Limited holding 2,445,625 Class B shares. No board recommendation, advisor, price, premium, or deal mechanics were disclosed. The filing is an ordinary EGM results notice, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
